name: kirchnervjohnson.com
notes: Static Next export (output: 'export'), the same shape as kirchner.ink. STATIC is the mode for local development here: `npm run build` typechecks and exports into out/, then `serve` (a devDependency, so npx resolves it offline) serves out/ on 3401 with clean URLs and byte ranges (the PDF viewers of the review architecture range-load). Not launched: robots disallow-all and noindex until launch; the front page is the Case Review window (owner's word 2026-10-06), /review forwards to it. No env file, no backend, nothing Netlify-only yet; the SAMEORIGIN/CSP headers in netlify.toml apply only on Netlify. `pages` (read by the Studio's DEVICES run): nothing excluded; the front page carries the window and its PDFs.
